### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **4** package(s): `@objectstack/driver-sql`, `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/plugin-approvals`, `@objectstack/plugin-sharing`, touching **20** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/objectql/src/tenancy/system-write-organization.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**25** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e5f194ba13d8d9a2818c1ece98a9c206fa0c7623`.

⛔ **12** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/objectql/src/tenancy/system-write-organization.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **30** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e5f194ba13d8d9a2818c1ece98a9c206fa0c7623` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `a7059442db1ad2925cb5b1c259ad83b67a208ae1` — the merge of head `aaa6ef6aa5ab46a82ba247dd58d6a2f92a304626` into base `e5f194ba13d8d9a2818c1ece98a9c206fa0c7623`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin a7059442db1ad2925cb5b1c259ad83b67a208ae1 && git checkout a7059442db1ad2925cb5b1c259ad83b67a208ae1
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin e5f194ba13d8d9a2818c1ece98a9c206fa0c7623 aaa6ef6aa5ab46a82ba247dd58d6a2f92a304626 && git checkout -B drift-repro e5f194ba13d8d9a2818c1ece98a9c206fa0c7623 && git merge --no-ff aaa6ef6aa5ab46a82ba247dd58d6a2f92a304626

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e5f194ba13d8d9a2818c1ece98a9c206fa0c7623
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs e5f194ba13d8d9a2818c1ece98a9c206fa0c7623` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `aaa6ef6aa5ab46a82ba247dd58d6a2f92a304626`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-tenant-audit-posture.test.ts, packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts, packages/objectql/src/engine.ts, packages/objectql/src/index.ts, packages/objectql/src/tenancy-by-object-classification.test.ts, packages/objectql/src/tenancy/platform-object-tenancy.ts (deleted), packages/objectql/src/tenancy/system-write-organization.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/business-unit-member-org-screen.test.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/business-unit-graph.ts, scripts/check-platform-object-tenancy-census.mjs, scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.json, scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.mjs + .github/workflows/lint.yml (the census step, origin/main), package.json (the two census script entries), docs/adr/0131-total-organization-ownership-no-null-organization-id.md (D9, D13, lines 56 and 1249), docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md (the runtime-export-retired category), scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs (CATEGORIES), scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs (the none-at-patch rule), packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-inventory.ts (the census's second reader), scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs, scripts/check-tenant-audit-census.mjs, content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx, packages/services/service-messaging/src/delivery-claim-tenant-audit.integration.test.ts (the one external matcher of the warning), scripts/audits/14096-tenancy-ledger-namespace-regexp-census.mjs (the one external importer), packages/spec/src/automation/schedule-organization.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/driver.zod.ts, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md, objectui at the pinned .objectui-sha cd14d8eeffe1

Read as: card #25201 (body, both comments), the reconciliation note 6339761793 on #15212, ADR-0131 D9/D13 on origin/main, PR #25210's body and file list, the net diff 9c431bad..aaa6ef6a (14 files, +263/-501; merge-base re-confirmed against origin/main 15764cd7), and the check-runs on the head. Check-runs, latest run per name (41 names): every one is success or skipped. `18.x upgrade harness (opt-in)` success 12:54:44Z (the needs:upgrade-harness lane; its first run was the skip before the label), `Check Changeset` success 12:50:52Z (four runs, all success), `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core` 6/6, `Build Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Check Documentation Links` success. `Part-of PR must not also close its card` failed once on the first body (closing keyword) and is success on the reworded body. Scope note: the brief's floor named packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/business-unit-member-org-screen.test.ts; the PR's file is packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/business-unit-member-org-screen.test.ts and plugin-sharing has no file of that name on the list — reviewed at the real path.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Removed published exports — RIGHT.** The index.ts hunk drops six names from `@objectstack/objectql`'s barrel: `PLATFORM_OBJECT_TENANCY`, `classifyPlatformObjectTenancy`, `isPlatformObjectOutOfTenantAuditScope`, `tenantScopedPlatformObjects`, and the types `PlatformObjectTenancy`, `PlatformObjectTenancyEntry`. Importers, measured on origin/main by git grep (CHANGELOGs excluded): inside the package, engine.ts (the mute) and the classification test, both rewritten in this diff; outside the package, exactly one, scripts/audits/14096-tenancy-ledger-namespace-regexp-census.mjs, a dated one-off that imports the built dist and that no package.json script, workflow or gate roster runs. Every other hit is prose: ADR-0131 lines 56, 878 and 1249, the 2026-09 audit record, platform-readings.md:403, the spec zod docblock and its generated mdx. objectui at the pinned .objectui-sha cd14d8eeffe1 carries zero references, so the Console Pin Gate cannot be broken by the removal (Post-Task #4 holds). `isPlatformNamespaceObject` stays exported, and the new tombstone pin's regex (PlatformObject or PLATFORM_OBJECT) does not match it — right. The cloud repository is outside this brief's inputs and was not measured; the changeset's BREAKING banner and six FROM → TO lines are its carrier.

2. **The mute's new structural rule — RIGHT, and it does NOT mute exactly what the ledger muted; it must not.** At base the audit was in scope when: tenant column, not federated, and not (platform-namespace object whose ledger verdict was anything but tenant-scoped). At head: tenant column and not federated. The ledger admitted nine objects (sys_file, sys_upload_session, sys_approval_request, sys_approval_action, sys_approval_approver, sys_automation_run, sys_notification, sys_notification_delivery, sys_record_share) and muted every other platform-namespace object by absence. Against the head's census (84 objects, 41 in reach, 43 out) the mute set shrinks by 32 platform objects that carry a tenant column (sys_activity, sys_approval_delegation, sys_approval_token, sys_attachment, sys_audience_binding_suggestion, sys_business_unit, sys_business_unit_member, sys_comment, sys_comment_reaction, sys_email, sys_email_template, sys_http_delivery, sys_import_job, sys_inbox_message, sys_invitation, sys_mail_association, sys_mail_message, sys_mailbox, sys_member, sys_notification_preference, sys_notification_receipt, sys_notification_template, sys_scim_connection_credential, sys_setting, sys_setting_audit, sys_share_link, sys_sharing_rule, sys_team, sys_user_permission_set, sys_user_position, sys_user_preference, sys_webhook), plus any cloud_ or ai_ object with a tenant column that this tree cannot see. What still mutes: the 43 reach-out objects (managedBy better-auth, systemFields.tenant false, tenancy.enabled false) and federated objects; an explicit caller value is still honoured, the branch only fills undefined. Is anything a write depends on inside the mute set? Readers of `bypassTenantAudit` at head (git grep, tests excluded): the SQL driver's `auditMissingTenant` early return at sql-driver.ts:15999 is the ONLY behavioural reader; the rest are the engine's pass-through allow-list (engine.ts:607), spec's DriverOptions schema (described as diagnostics-only), the hook-api type, and callers that set the option. No memory or mongodb driver reads it. So the mute decides one WARN line and nothing a write touches — right. The pins read consistently with the dev's ablation, which I did not re-run: the it.each "NOT auto-muted" pin for sys_audit_entry and the "SAME driver options" pin against dispatch_order are exactly the two a per-table re-entry would red; the derive and refusal pins never read the option.

3. **Write paths — RIGHT, unchanged in every posture.** The engine.ts hunks are the import removal, the `isTenantAuditInScope` expression and comments; `resolveSystemInsertOrganization` is untouched, so D9 derivation under single and refusal under group and isolated are as at base. The sql-driver.ts hunks are a docblock and the warn string; `applyTenantScope`, `injectTenantOnInsert` and `computeTenantField` are untouched. Under a walled posture the only observable delta is WARN lines on elevated writes that reach the driver with no tenantId on the 32 objects above.

4. **The [tenant-audit] warning's new text — RIGHT.** The prefix `[tenant-audit] OP on tenant-scoped object "OBJECT" without options.tenantId` and the metadata object (object, op, tenantField) are byte-identical, so the one external matcher found, service-messaging's delivery-claim integration test at line 64, still matches. The tail drops "Pass tenantId" — which, under D8, is the one change that would break a wall-exempt admin's cross-organization update — and names both readings with a remedy each. The runtime string carries no tracker number (check:doc-authoring is inside the green Lint lane). Two caveats, neither blocking: (a) "the row's own organization column does not scope an update or a delete" is true of the driver and silent about creates, where the line also fires (the create and bulkCreate call sites); noise on an insert whose row carries its organization is pre-existing for application objects and now reaches the 32 platform objects too — the dev's own observation, handled in ③; (b) a wall-exempt admin's REST write has no caller who can declare `bypassTenantAudit:true`, since the engine sets the mute only for isSystem, so that line keeps firing under a wall; the text names the reading honestly, and moving the declaration into the engine is 8c-1 design space, not this card.

5. **The census tooling's new meaning — RIGHT, and lint.yml's step still checks something real.** The generator never read the ledger: it executes `resolveTenantFieldName` and `resolveInjectedSystemColumns` on every packages/**/*.object.ts. The change is prose in lockstep: `HEADER` moves from the deleted ledger to system-write-organization.ts, whose new `resolveTenantFieldName` docblock carries all three HEADER_MARKERS (the artefact path, the predicate name, "registered schema"); the artefact's $comment and the generator's ARTEFACT_COMMENT move together, so verdict 1 (byte-equal render) holds, and no row moved (84/41/43). The new meaning: reach-in is the whole of the engine's tenancy scope, system-write rule and audit alike. The lint.yml step "Platform-object tenancy census matches the tree" (continue-on-error, folded into the Lane verdict) runs the same two commands unchanged and its three verdicts — drift, header pointer, unexplained exclusion — are all still live; `Lint & Repo Gates` success and the dev's --ran agree. One marker is weakened, not holed: `resolveTenantFieldName` is now trivially present in the file that defines it; the other two markers still bind. The CLI inventory reads the artefact's rows, not its comment — unaffected. The sibling scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs never modelled the mute by ledger or by namespace (no six-name hit; its PLATFORM_TYPES are TypeScript globals) — unaffected. A minor imprecision in the new docblock and $comment: both say non-null ⇒ in the audit and omit the not-federated term the code keeps; moot for the platform namespaces, none of which is external.

6. **Docblocks — RIGHT against ADR-0131 as shipped.** approval-service.ts, business-unit-graph.ts, the B3 test comment and system-write-organization.ts now describe C1 (seed replay stamps), D9 (derive or refuse) and D13 (no per-table exemption), and stop citing #14570 and the ledger. The claim that this takes #25203's item 4 is not verified by this record (#25203 is outside the brief's inputs); the rewrites stand on their own reading of the ADR.

7. **R1–R4 — cannot be affected by this diff, and the head's gates agree.** No boot, ceremony, refusal, schema, DDL or migration path is touched. R1: `Dogfood Regression Gate` success; the dev's fresh boot answered 200. R2: `18.x upgrade harness (opt-in)` success at 12:54:44Z on this head, plus the dev's 15/15 on both fixture legs. R3: the v17 refusal lives in boot code the diff does not reach. R4: the dev's walled os serve answered 200 and printed 43 WARN lines in the new text — the only R4-visible change, diagnostics only.

8. **Governance and shape.** No governed path on the file list (`Governed Surface Queue Guard` success; check-governed-merges --branch NOT governed). Head repo equals base repo. Draft, no auto-merge armed.

### ② Semver level

RIGHT. .changeset/25201-platform-object-tenancy-ledger-retired.md grades `@objectstack/objectql` patch and `@objectstack/driver-sql` patch; `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` is identical on the PR body and in the changeset; `Metadata-protocol: none`; the bold BREAKING banner is present with the sentence that says why it ships at patch; and exactly one ADR-0087 marker is carried, an HTML comment reading adr-0087: not-required (runtime-export-retired @objectstack/objectql#PLATFORM_OBJECT_TENANCY, …#classifyPlatformObjectTenancy, …#isPlatformObjectOutOfTenantAuditScope, …#tenantScopedPlatformObjects, …#PlatformObjectTenancy, …#PlatformObjectTenancyEntry) with its why. That is the seventh category ADR-0087 added on 2026-10-12 for retired published runtime exports with no metadata surface — exactly this diff: no Zod key, no spec declaration and no stored shape moves, objectstack migrate meta has nothing to rewrite, and no tombstone is owed. The migration section gives six FROM → TO lines, one per removed name, pointing at `resolveTenantFieldName` (still exported) and the census. The level follows the repo rule as check-changeset-no-major.mjs encodes it: no (narrowing) beside none grades none-clean, every introduced entry patch, the BREAKING banner and the ADR-0087 marker carried. driver-sql's change is a log string behind an unchanged prefix — patch. Only the two packages whose published source moves are listed; plugin-approvals and plugin-sharing change comments only, so omitting them is right. `Check Changeset` success on all four runs.

### ③ Boundary flags

The dev's open_questions is empty. The dev's three out_of_scope_findings, restated in the PR body's Acceptance notes and Observation, each answered or escalated:

1. **Residue of PLATFORM_OBJECT_TENANCY outside CHANGELOGs — answered; two items escalated to the seat.** The card's literal acceptance "git grep returns nothing outside CHANGELOGs" is not met and cannot be met by this PR: two hits are governed (.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md:403, Tier S; docs/adr/0131 at lines 56, 878 and 1249, Tier H, where 878 is the D13 retirement list itself), two are dated records (docs/audits/2026-09-tenancy-ledger-namespace-regexp-census.md; scripts/audits/14096-tenancy-ledger-namespace-regexp-census.mjs, which now throws at import as its own docblock prescribes). Live code and tests: zero hits. Escalated: (a) platform-readings.md:403 states a reading that is now false — 「租户普查 `reach: in` 只说有租户列;D9 系统写盖章只认 `PLATFORM_OBJECT_TENANCY` 的 `tenant-scoped`。」 — false since stage 8b and doubly so now; the seat cuts the Tier S edit; (b) the seat decides whether the dated audit script stays as a loud-failing record or is deleted. The ADR needs no amendment: D13 names the retirement and lines 56 and 1249 are dated anchors.

2. **Docs drift the dev found — escalated to #25203 (stale-text carriers).** packages/spec/src/automation/schedule-organization.zod.ts:76 and its generated content/docs/references/automation/schedule-organization.mdx cite the deleted path for the sys_automation_run evidence; a packages/spec docblock edit regenerates the page and is not this card's surface. Added by this review, same carrier: content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx lines 49-50 say the engine mutes every isSystem write — stale since #13491 and further from true now; it is hand-written prose outside check-tenant-audit-census's gated region. Also the comment at delivery-claim-tenant-audit.integration.test.ts:11-14 quotes the old tail while the test asserts only the unchanged prefix — cosmetic.

3. **Create-noise under a wall — answered, and escalated as a follow-up card.** An elevated insert whose row carries organization_id reaches the driver with no tenantId and warns; pre-existing for application objects, now reaching 32 platform objects; diagnostics only, no write changes; the ruled direction (a warning, never a silent rewrite). The seat should file it in the 8c-1 design space: skip the insert audit when the row carries its tenant field, and let the engine declare the D8 wall-exemption to the driver so an exempt admin's write is not told to declare an option it cannot set. Not blocking.

4. **Claim-comment constraints — answered.** No .github/workflows/** change is needed (lint.yml's step still checks something real, judgment ①5); package.json's two census scripts are untouched and still valid; no ORGANIZATION_OWNERSHIP_SHAPE_GENERATION or ceremony change is in the diff.

5. **Not verified by this record, named so the seat knows:** the cloud repository's importers of the six names (outside the inputs; the changeset is the carrier), and the identity of #25203's item 4.

Seat ACCEPT · epic PM `session_01Y5583bs2RDd53MH6kM1ca3` (`os-steve`) · 2026-10-22T13:03Z. PR #25210 at `aaa6ef6aa5ab46a82ba247dd58d6a2f92a304626` (#25201; claim 6339794203; os-dev-report 6341129117). **ACCEPT.**

## Seat check

- **Shape:** 14 files, +263 / −501. `check-governed-merges --pr 25210`: 0 of 14 paths governed, so this is an ordinary queue landing. `.github/workflows/lint.yml` is untouched, and no Tier H follow-up is owed.
- **What it does:**
  - The `PLATFORM_OBJECT_TENANCY` ledger retires (ADR-0131 D13), along with six published `@objectstack/objectql` exports.
  - The engine's `bypassTenantAudit` isSystem mute is now decided by schema: a tenant column, not federated. A per-table list no longer decides it.
  - The `[tenant-audit]` warning keeps its prefix and stops telling a wall-exempt write to pass a tenantId.
  - The census tooling now points at the schema rule, and `lint.yml`'s step still checks it.
  - No write path, D9 stamping or refusal, boot, ceremony or schema code moves.
- **Review:** `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, narrowing face, from an isolated reviewer. **PASS** 6341425088 at this head.
  - The new mute is a strict subset of the old one: 32 platform objects with a tenant column lose the mute.
  - Its only behavioural reader is the SQL driver's warn early return (`sql-driver.ts:15999`; the seat re-checked it), so no write changes.
  - The changeset is right: `patch`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, the BREAKING banner, and one ADR-0087 `runtime-export-retired` marker naming the six exports.
- **CI:** the latest run of every check is success or skipped.
  - The opt-in `18.x upgrade harness` lane ran on this head (the seat applied `needs:upgrade-harness`) and passed.
  - The `Part-of` check's one failure is the 11:52 run on the first body; its later runs pass.
- **R1–R4:** no boot, ceremony or refusal code is touched.
  - Dogfood Regression Gate and the harness lane are green.
  - The dev's fresh boot and walled `os serve` both served 200, and full dogfood passed 2398/2398.
- **The review's escalations, and where each goes:**
  - `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md:403` states a reading this PR makes false. It is not governed. It joins #25203 once this merges.
  - Docs drift joins #25203: `schedule-organization.zod.ts:76` and its generated page, `content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx:49-50`, and the stale comment in `delivery-claim-tenant-audit.integration.test.ts`.
  - `scripts/audits/14096-tenancy-ledger-namespace-regexp-census.mjs` stays as a dated record. It now fails loudly at import, as its own docblock prescribes, and nothing runs it.
  - The walled create-noise warning is diagnostics only and pre-existing in kind. The seat files it as a p3 follow-up in the 8c-1 space.
  - The cloud repository's importers of the six names were not measured. The changeset's BREAKING banner and FROM → TO lines carry the change to it.
- **Landing:** the seat flips the PR ready and enables auto-merge. `Fixes #25201` closes the card.
